name: Blanche
source:
Princess Blanche is the eldest of king Louis' three daughters. She is serious and very religious and wants what's best for the subject of her kingdom. Behind her cold appearance, a kind and caring bride is hiding.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1469300/]Steam[/url]]
